name: Melon S.A.
summary: Melon S.A. produces and sells cement, concrete, and aggregates in Chile. Its products are used in high-rise building, household, industrial, mining, port, and civil works. Melon S.A. also sells its products online through the melononline.cl portal. The company was formerly known as Empresas Melón S.A. and changed its name to Melon S.A. in August 2009. Melon S.A. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Santiago, Chile.
